technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive momentum indicators, but extreme RSI(9) overbought condition and weak ADX trend strength create elevated pullback risk for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CFG shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 70 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (389+ days old) with only small-amount sales offering no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (312.0) with imminent CPI event in 2 days creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 70 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with three white soldiers pattern and RSI extreme overbought creates technical setup for continuation, while market fear (33/100) offers contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (312.0), imminent CPI event in 2 days, RSI(9) at 85.7 with weak ADX (19.9) trend strength, zero fundamental conviction, and no active strategy triggered create acute macro stress and elevated pullback risk that outweighs technical bullish structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with price above all major MAs and three white soldiers pattern, but extreme RSI(9) overbought at 85.7 combined with weak ADX (19.9) signals imminent pullback risk rather than continuation. Contrarian fear opportunity exists, but macro headwinds (VIX crisis 312.0, CPI in 2 days) and zero fundamental conviction make this a poor risk/reward entry point.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis regime with imminent CPI event in 2 days creates acute macro volatility that will likely trigger RSI(9) overbought pullback, risking 5–8% downside before any recovery.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical bullish structure is offset by macro stress, overbought conditions, and zero fundamental support
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding CFG with 49 existing Financials positions (13% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further and argue for skip rather than add.
